Aug. 6 Mrs. Anna Bonnell - 27 - new-break 8 months ago ... birth of baby
6 Mrs. Wella Blett - 45 - deaf mute and bumb - (seemingly) intelligent and alert, capable - has had good positions - looking for something to do now - 1604 Delaware Ave.
6 Thanks - Marg. Campble - 10 - pneumonia three years ago - fever 106 in Harper - no hope given of recovery - is here To-day OK.
6th Peter Maniaci - 32 - Epileptic 5 yrs - has them about every 2nd day. Charles Reid - 16 - in Receiving Hosp. - Father - non Cath. asks for prayers. .
7 Anne McCarthy - 12 - infantile paralysis ... They fear mental effects
8 Julia A. Maloney - 46 - T.B. Spine feared Robert W. Guyer - 18 - Renkenridge, Pa. - Spastic paralysis. .. ..
Page 293
Aug. 11 Alfred Yockey - 47 - "First Christian Church", had been raised luth- eran. Went to St. Mary's Hosp. Catholic wife called for prayers and "phone enrollment 26th. Next Day "double lancing of ears - even though he felt positively better - has never been well since ... To- day the two come to Enroll ... $5.00
12 Mrs. H. P. Hughes - Lansing, Mich. - 65 - Cataracts; fears operation · .
13th
Mrs. Laura Gould - 73 - of Port Huron totally blind since operation some months ago; still hoping one eye may be recovered.
Patricia Martin - 9 - had cerebrel-hemorage as infant and though seemingly bright can not speak. One word however - she can say per- fectly, "Mama".
Agnes Roulo - 65 - fell - weeks ago injured her spine ..... bad shape
Harry Ludwig - 48 - Throat cancer - has a wife and two daughters .... Condition becoming very threatening. . Page 294 August Joyce Bandemer - 6 - sickly since birth - can not talk; is able to say i.e. tries to say words.
